reconciler_event.hazard: While this card waits in scheduled and u2 has no sentinel, any active reconciler tick would keep releasing the card on u1's stale FAILED (one worker spawn per 15m tick; each spawn only re-parks). Keep the reconciler paused until u2's terminal sentinel exists - a single release then is correct (idempotent afterwards because the card leaves scheduled). The superseded-attempt sentinel re-arm is a multi-attempt consumption edge not modelled by 9.4 (its consumption rule is card-status-based, and 9.3 mandates release on any terminal). Changing runtime/reconcile.py would be a contract code change (9.4 item 4; 26: version bump + tests + audit) and is out of scope for this card - flagged for operator/ChatGPT.
